# Sprint

> An agent-forward React component library. Every component renders a styled human view and projects a plain-Markdown agent view from the same definition, and registers its actions as WebMCP tools (document.modelContext, Chrome 149+).

Component roots carry `data-sprint="<ComponentName>"`, addressable parts carry `data-sprint-part`, and runtime state is reflected as `data-sprint-<state>` attributes. WebMCP tool names follow `<scope>-<verb>-<label-slug>`.

## Components

- [Alert](/components/Alert.md): A status message for the outcome of something that already happened: a notice, a warning, or a failure.
- [Avatar](/components/Avatar.md): A person's photo in a circle, falling back to their initials when there is no photo or it fails to load.
- [Breadcrumb](/components/Breadcrumb.md): A navigation landmark that renders as one line: the path to the current page, where every crumb opens the level it sits in. Every destination in the tree stays in the page as an addressable part; the crumbs decide which of them a person is shown.
- [Button](/components/Button.md): A single action a person or an agent can trigger. Registers one press tool named from its own label.
- [Card](/components/Card.md): One entry in a catalogue: a title, a line or two of body, and the whole block clickable. Give it an href and it is a link; give it onClick and it is an action that registers an open tool.
- [ChangeList](/components/ChangeList.md): A review of what will change or has changed: each row is marked added, removed or changed, and a changed row reads from → to. The kind of every row is a glyph, a tone and spoken text at once, and an agent reads it as state rather than from the glyph.
- [Checkbox](/components/Checkbox.md): A single on/off choice recorded as form data. It registers one set tool that takes the end state rather than toggling.
- [ChoiceGrid](/components/ChoiceGrid.md): A question answered by pressing one of several large, equal-sized tiles, each a glyph such as an emoji over a text label. It works in two modes: submit mode, where every tile is a real submit button carrying its value, and select mode, where the tiles are a radio group driven by value and onChange.
- [CodeBlock](/components/CodeBlock.md): A snippet of code with a caption band and a copy control. In agent view the snippet is carried verbatim as the code part, so an agent reads the source instead of the highlighting.
- [Combobox](/components/Combobox.md): A searchable single-choice field for long lists: type to filter, arrow to an option, Enter to pick. Options can be grouped, described, limited per group and rendered your own way. Registers one choose tool that takes a label or a search.
- [CopyField](/components/CopyField.md): A labelled, read-only value with a Copy control: a setup link, an invite URL, a webhook address. The value truncates with an ellipsis on one line, stays selectable, and the control confirms with Copied for two seconds.
- [DescriptionList](/components/DescriptionList.md): Labelled term–description pairs for the details of one thing: metadata, settings, profile fields.
- [Dialog](/components/Dialog.md): A modal that interrupts the page for one decision: confirm a destructive action, complete a short step, acknowledge something before continuing.
- [Disclosure](/components/Disclosure.md): A labelled region a person can show or hide with a toggle that carries its expanded state. Collapsing conceals the content from a person only: it stays in the page, and the agent view always renders it.
- [Divider](/components/Divider.md): A horizontal rule that segments a page: the line between a header or a breadcrumb and the body under it, or between two runs of content. It draws in the active theme's own keyline or band, and can name the segment it opens.
- [EmptyState](/components/EmptyState.md): A region that says there is nothing here, and why: a headline, an optional sentence, and an optional way out such as clearing filters or creating the first record. It marks the empty field with the register's own empty ornament.
- [EntityRow](/components/EntityRow.md): One record in a list of records, as a single clickable row: a title, a few Tags, and one line of meta. Give it an href and the whole row is a link; give it onSelect and it is an action that registers an open tool.
- [Heading](/components/Heading.md): A section title, rendered as a real h element at the level you pick so it joins the document outline.
- [Image](/components/Image.md): A framed picture in a slot that holds its shape. It is the one component whose content an agent cannot read, so alt is not decoration: it is the whole of what the agent gets, and the source URL is published beside it for an agent that can fetch pixels of its own.
- [Kbd](/components/Kbd.md): A keyboard key or shortcut, drawn as key caps. Pass the combination as text joined with plus signs.
- [Link](/components/Link.md): A navigation link. It publishes its destination as state, so an agent reading the page in text learns the URL rather than having to click to find out, and it renders a real anchor in both views.
- [List](/components/List.md): A bulleted or numbered list built from an array of items. Each item is an addressable part carrying its position, so an agent can cite item three without counting lines.
- [Menu](/components/Menu.md): A button that opens a short list of actions, links, or one-of-several choices. Registers one choose tool enumerating the items an agent can run.
- [MetaLine](/components/MetaLine.md): A slash-separated manifest line of term–detail pairs: serials, build strings, issue dates. It is chrome, not content, and in the agent view it reads as the same single line of text a person sees.
- [Nav](/components/Nav.md): A labelled navigation landmark: the region that holds a page's links to elsewhere.
- [NavGroup](/components/NavGroup.md): A labelled cluster of links inside a Nav. The label names the group for screen readers and agents alike.
- [PageHeader](/components/PageHeader.md): The top of a page: its h1 title, the Tag chips that classify it, an optional page-level control, and a lede underneath.
- [Pagination](/components/Pagination.md): A navigation landmark for a long set shown one page at a time: Previous and Next controls, a "Page 2 of 3" readout, and a "Showing 26–50 of 61" summary of which items are on screen. It takes counts rather than items, so it works the same over a local array or a server query.
- [Panel](/components/Panel.md): A labelled region with a header band and an optional slot for the controls that act on it. Everything on a Sprint page lives inside one.
- [Pending](/components/Pending.md): Marks a region whose data is being fetched. Keeps stale content visible and readable while it refreshes, and holds a labelled pending field when there is nothing to show yet.
- [Progress](/components/Progress.md): A labelled loading indicator for work in progress. Indeterminate by default; pass value for a known fraction complete.
- [Prose](/components/Prose.md): Typography for long-form rendered content such as Markdown: headings, paragraphs, lists, links, code, tables and quotes, in the theme's voice.
- [RadioGroup](/components/RadioGroup.md): One choice from a short list of options, each a native radio button with a label and an optional line of description. Registers one select tool enumerating the options.
- [SearchField](/components/SearchField.md): A search box inside its own search landmark: a labelled query field with a clear control, Escape to clear, Enter to submit, and an optional page-wide key that focuses it. It registers one search tool that sets the query and submits it.
- [SecretField](/components/SecretField.md): A sensitive value shown once or on demand: an API key, a recovery code, a signing secret. Masked by default with reveal and copy controls, and the value never reaches any agent surface.
- [SegmentedControl](/components/SegmentedControl.md): A short row of mutually exclusive options, all visible at once: a radio group that registers a single select tool whose schema enumerates the options currently on screen.
- [Select](/components/Select.md): A dropdown of mutually exclusive options: a select-only combobox that opens a listbox on click or keyboard, carrying its own label, hint, and error. It registers a single select tool whose schema enumerates the option labels currently on offer.
- [Shell](/components/Shell.md): The page-level frame: a sidebar and a main content region, with the landmark wiring done once. On a phone the sidebar becomes a drawer behind a menu button.
- [Spinner](/components/Spinner.md): A small inline busy mark for work with no measurable progress, sized to sit inside a field or beside a line of text.
- [Stack](/components/Stack.md): The one-dimensional layout primitive: a row, a column, or an auto-filling grid, with spacing drawn from the space scale. It renders a plain box and nothing else.
- [Steps](/components/Steps.md): An ordered set of numbered steps a person works through: each one a number badge, a short title and an optional body, with a rule between them. A step can be marked done or current, so the list doubles as a record of how far someone has got.
- [Switch](/components/Switch.md): An on/off setting that takes effect the moment it changes. It registers one set tool that takes the end state rather than toggling.
- [Table](/components/Table.md): A data grid built from columns and rows rather than from markup. In the agent stream it reads as a compact Markdown table; in the DOM each cell is addressable as a part carrying its column and row. On a narrow screen every row restacks into a labelled block instead of scrolling sideways.
- [Tabs](/components/Tabs.md): Sibling views of one subject, one shown at a time, with real tablist, tab and tabpanel semantics. Registers one select tool enumerating the tabs.
- [Tag](/components/Tag.md): A small chip that classifies the thing next to it: a status, a category, a count, a build string.
- [Text](/components/Text.md): A run of prose, sized and toned from the semantic scale. In agent view it renders as its own text content, so an agent reads the words rather than inferring them from styling.
- [Textarea](/components/Textarea.md): A multi-line text area carrying its own label, hint, and error. Fully controlled, and it registers one fill tool that replaces the whole content with an explicit value, line breaks included.
- [TextInput](/components/TextInput.md): A single-line text field carrying its own label, hint, and error. Fully controlled, and it registers one fill tool that replaces the field's text with an explicit value.
- [Toast](/components/Toast.md): A brief message that floats at the bottom of the screen after something happened, with an optional single action such as Undo, and dismisses itself.
- [Tooltip](/components/Tooltip.md): A short hint that appears beside one control on hover or keyboard focus. A human affordance only: it adds nothing to the agent view.
- [VisuallyHidden](/components/VisuallyHidden.md): Text that is off screen but still read by screen readers and agents. For context a sighted person gets from the layout.

## Reference

- [agent-manifest.json](/agent-manifest.json): the machine-readable catalogue of every component, prop, state attribute, example, and WebMCP tool descriptor
